extract_species_id_from_msa_description: use get_identifiers to extract the species ID from a UniProt MSA sequence description string
parse_uniprot_sequence_identifier: use _parse_sequence_identifier to parse a UniProt sequence identifier and return an Identifiers dataclass with the species ID
extract_sequence_identifier_from_descrip: use _extract_sequence_identifier to extract the first token from an MSA description string as a sequence identifier
create_identifiers_dataclass: create an Identifiers frozen dataclass instance with a species_id string field defaulting to empty
match_uniprot_pattern: use the _UNIPROT_PATTERN regex to match UniProtKB TREMBL or Swiss-Prot entry names and capture accession and species identifiers
